Scene:
  identity: expansive dreamlike classical garden complex
  landform: complex floating as a group of irregular islands in calm blue water
  horizon: hazy mountains
  sky: soft pink-blue
  atmosphere: serene, ornate, slightly fantastical
Layout:
  network: dense but orderly pale stone walkways, lawns, courtyards, canals, ponds, bridges, terraces, low interconnected garden structures
  core: more rectilinear, tightly woven, opening into broad organically curved lawns at the perimeter
Architecture:
  materials: peach and cream stucco, pink stone trim
  details: decorative bands, fluted columns, brick-lined arches, balustrades
  pergolas: occasional, draped in vines and hanging purple flowers
  predominant forms: low walls, arcades, gateways, covered passages, rounded pavilions rather than enclosed multistory buildings
  placement: clustered along waterways
  orientation: structures facing gardens or pools
Waterways:
  network: narrow turquoise canals and rounded lily ponds throughout complex
  crossings: waterways passing beneath small bridges, raised archways, and open colonnades
  level changes: several short waterfalls or spillways between levels
Main landmass:
  edges: wide pale cobbled promenades, curving retaining walls
  inlets: water-filled, between projecting garden lobes
Offshore islands:
  quantity: several detached circular pavilion islands
  each base: concentric grassy terraces
  each perimeter: arched walls
  each crown: a small domed open gazebo at the crown
Planting:
  location: lawns
  character: formal yet varied
  inventory: clipped hedges, flower beds, topiary, tall slender trees, willows, flowering trees, shrubs, urn planters, scattered circular planting beds
Finish:
  water: glossy, reflective
  masonry: bright, sunlit
  grass: lush, saturated
  trellises: occasional, elevated

=== THE TASK ===
Rebuild the place described above on the 200 m x 200 m plate, at the density
and arrangement the description calls for. Budget is 800 tool calls and 180
minutes; every tool result reports how much of both you have spent. Spend as
much or as little as the job needs, and decide for yourself when the scene
matches the description.

deterministic_rule_draft.prompt:
Scene:
  identity: expansive dreamlike classical garden complex
  landform: complex floating as a group of irregular islands in calm blue water
  horizon: hazy mountains
  sky: soft pink-blue
  atmosphere: serene, ornate, slightly fantastical
Layout:
  network: dense but orderly pale stone walkways, lawns, courtyards, canals, ponds, bridges, terraces, low interconnected garden structures
  core: more rectilinear, tightly woven, opening into broad organically curved lawns at the perimeter
Architecture:
  materials: peach and cream stucco, pink stone trim
  details: decorative bands, fluted columns, brick-lined arches, balustrades
  pergolas: occasional, draped in vines and hanging purple flowers
  predominant forms: low walls, arcades, gateways, covered passages, rounded pavilions rather than enclosed multistory buildings
  placement: clustered along waterways
  orientation: structures facing gardens or pools
Waterways:
  network: narrow turquoise canals and rounded lily ponds throughout complex
  crossings: waterways passing beneath small bridges, raised archways, and open colonnades
  level changes: several short waterfalls or spillways between levels
Main landmass:
  edges: wide pale cobbled promenades, curving retaining walls
  inlets: water-filled, between projecting garden lobes
Offshore islands:
  quantity: several detached circular pavilion islands
  each base: concentric grassy terraces
  each perimeter: arched walls
  each crown: a small domed open gazebo at the crown
Planting:
  location: lawns
  character: formal yet varied
  inventory: clipped hedges, flower beds, topiary, tall slender trees, willows, flowering trees, shrubs, urn planters, scattered circular planting beds
Finish:
  water: glossy, reflective
  masonry: bright, sunlit
  grass: lush, saturated
  trellises: occasional, elevated
